title: Fixed-length copy may leave the string unterminated (c)
description: The code copies with strncpy. When the source is at least as long as the destination no terminator is written, and every later string operation reads past the buffer. This lexical rule flags the copy; the reviewer checks the terminator.
remediation: Terminate explicitly after the copy or use a helper that always terminates, for example snprintf with an explicit format.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches the copy without proving the source is shorter than the destination.
